title: Filler state manipulation causes denial-of-service across Folio operations
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  As the `sync()` modifier, which reverts if `swapActive()` returns `true`, is used in many crucial functions in `Folio` and also the `FolioDAOFeeRegistry`, this can be exploited to cause a DoS on protocol operations including:  1. `mint()` and `redeem()` functions, blocking users from entering or exiting positions. 2. Auction functions, preventing the protocol from executing trades. 3. Fee distribution functions, disrupt the protocol's economic model. 4.
